research_question: which clause of the DMR-IR prompt carries the metadata-only score
comparison: Pinto et al. 2025 Table III: 0.918 accuracy from a linear probe on embeddings of this same text, image-level split, no test set
protocol_difference: patient-level 5x5 folds; TF-IDF and classifier fitted inside each fold so the test partition's vocabulary never informs training
encoder_difference: TF-IDF bigrams, not a sentence-transformer; the comparison is between clauses, not against their absolute number
age_pair_scope_note: the prompt carries only age_at_visit, so the age_current pair channel of scripts/25 (AUROC 0.946) is NOT available here and does not explain Table III
